name: Logly

evidence.web: F02: primary category is hosted website traffic analytics; F15: pageviews, sessions, pages, referrers and countries

line: Tracks website pageviews and separates bot traffic.

pv.math: The free plan covers up to 10,000 pageviews a month on one site.
Starter is $9 a month if you qualify for early access. The later published price is $15 a month.
Pro is $29 a month if you qualify for early access. The later published price is $49 a month.
